fee_notes: Roto-Rooter uses a population-based Monthly Franchise Fee (not a % of gross sales) ranging from $280 to $36,000+ per month, calculated using a tiered Franchise Fee per Population (FFP) formula: $507.00/month per 100,000 population (Tier 1: first 500k), $480.32 (Tier 2: second 500k), $453.62 (Tier 3: over 1M). Tiers are increased by 10%/25%/30% (or 5%/10%/15% if fewer than half of company units provide Water Restoration Services). Fee adjusts annually via CPI and every 5 years for population changes. Minimum monthly fee is $280. Local advertising spend is required at per-person rates escalating from 11.11¢/person (2026) to 13.81¢/person (2035), spent annually by franchisee; if unspent, the shortfall is remitted to franchisor. Transfer fee is 1.5% of total sale price, min $1,000, max $7,500. No renewal fee currently charged. Administrative fees of $200 for partner add/drop or stock ownership change.
raw_excerpt:
Monthly Franchise Fee | From $280 to $36,000+ per month based on population formula which increases every January. | Payable on the 1st day of the month, in advance. | Adjustable annually based on change in CPI and water restoration. May be reduced by rebates we provide. Adjusted every 5-years for changes in population. On renewal, adjusted for Roto-Rooter's industry specific pricing inflation and increases in market penetration.

Transfer | 1½% of the total sale price, with a minimum of $1,000 and not to exceed $7,500 | Prior to consummation of transfer | Payable when the Franchise Agreement or any interest in you or it is transferred.

Renewal Fee | Currently we do not charge any fee although we have the right to do so.

Local Advertising | You must spend not less than; 11.11¢ per person in 2026, 11.38¢ per person in 2027, 11.65¢ per person in 2028, 11.92¢ per person in 2029, 12.22¢ per person in 2030, 12.52¢ per person in 2031, 12.82¢ per person in 2032, 13.14¢ per person in 2033, 13.47¢ per person in 2034, And 13.81¢ per person in 2035. | Must be spent annually by you. If you fail to do so, you must pay to us, within 14 days after the end of the Agreement Year, the amount you did not spend.

Administrative Fees | Add partner - $200.00; Drop partner - $200.00; Change of stock ownership - $200.00. | Prior to consummation of ownership change.
